statement: Claude D'/D5 cross-volume certificates are not exhaustive even inside the strict N3 no-pivot class: for every fixed tau>0 and even m with 1/m<tau, Q_m=2 X_0 m^{-1/2} sum_j Y_j +(m^{-1/2} sum_k Z_k)^2 has spectrum {1,1,-1}, all physical diagonals and 2x2 principal determinants below tau, yet every coordinate cross block has rank at most two, so Z_3=Z_5=0 for every cut. This is not a QFORM counterexample: mixed-hub Theorem H gives ||p_Qm||_infinity <=3*2^(4/3)<7.560 uniformly in m and all cap-one product laws.
self_correction: The first report draft attempted a general shear-stable null-hub extension of Theorem H. The corrected report withdraws that claim because the shear creates a nonseparable amplitude f_0(z-h.x') prod f_j(x_j), so the Brascamp-Lieb product hypothesis is not preserved. The N3 stress-family obstruction and direct mixed-hub application do not use that invalid step.
